usedFor: Way We Do runs checklists, and Google Docs logs results through “Checklist Finished” and “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “Checklist Finished” in Way We Do, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: A finished checklist writes its outcome into a tab of a Google Doc.

watchOut: “Add or Replace Text In Tab” can replace the tab's existing content, so choose adding when you want a history.
